1.mascotDialogue: Nothing clever here: compare your neighbour, swap if you're bigger, and repeat the sweep until nothing needs swapping.

2.mascotDialogue: `n minus i minus 1` on line 3 shrinks the inner loop's range each pass — the last i elements are already sorted, so there's no need to keep checking them.

3.mascotDialogue: Watch the tallest bar creep one step right with every swap it loses — that's the 'bubbling' this algorithm's named after, made entirely literal.

4.mascotDialogue: This one won't crash every time — it'll simply, occasionally, read rubbish past the array. Exactly the sort of bug that goes unnoticed, since it doesn't always announce itself.
